headline: No plausible interaction pathway: both agents are local-only, non-runnable, and expose no shared I/O or write surfaces.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Dagster and LlamaFactory expose no shared communication channel, no clipboard, no stdin/stdout bridge, no filesystem access, and no MCP use. With both agents non-runnable and local-only, there is no plausible default prompt-injection pathway between them.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared filesystem, clipboard, or message queue, reassess injection risk.
IF an orchestrator begins piping one agent's raw output into the other, the pathway becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep both agents isolated from shared IPC channels.
Do not wire raw outputs from one agent into the other's prompt.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a shared bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither Dagster nor LlamaFactory can read files, write files, or send network traffic by default, and both profiles show no data classes touched. Without a shared workspace or outbound transport, there is no credible leakage path between them.
conditions: IF either agent gains filesystem read access to a shared workspace, leakage risk changes.
IF either agent is configured to upload file contents or context to a backend, reassess.
mitigations: Keep sensitive data out of any shared directory.
requires-engineering: add explicit data-loss-prevention controls if storage or transport is enabled.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both profiles explicitly lack filesystem write, git modification, subprocess spawning, and network egress. With no overlapping mutable resource access and no concurrency primitives shown, there is no capability conflict to arbitrate.
conditions: IF either agent is granted write access to the same directory, conflict risk must be re-evaluated.
IF git or database mutation is added to both agents, locking becomes necessary.
mitigations: Avoid placing them on the same mutable workspace.
requires-engineering: introduce locks before enabling shared writes.

D_cascading_error.rationale: The pair has no documented input/output bridge, and neither agent exposes stdin/stdout or file surfaces that would let one agent's output become the other's authoritative input. Without a downstream action path, cascading error is not plausible here.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding Dagster outputs directly into LlamaFactory decisions, reassess.
IF either agent is given action-taking authority, cascading impact may emerge.
mitigations: Do not auto-consume one agent's outputs as facts for the other.
Require human review before any downstream action.
requires-engineering: add verification gates if an action chain is introduced.

E_compliance.rationale: No data classes are touched by either agent, and the profiles show no secrets, OAuth scopes, or residency-sensitive flows. With no identified regulated data movement, there is no compliance mismatch to score.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are later introduced into either profile, reassess residency and retention.
IF either agent begins logging user content, compliance review is needed.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents.
Avoid enabling logging of user content.
requires-engineering: document retention and residency controls before handling regulated data.
